title: pass@2
description: One axHub approval pass with its coverage (framework/spec/AXHUB-PASS.md). pass@2 adds `covers` to axHub's pass@1 record (axHub docs/veto-pass.md, PolicyPassSchema in packages/core/src/schemas.ts): `all` (the default) or an explicit list of service / tool / scope entries. A pass@1 record has no `covers`; every reader derives it with the migration in `x-migration` and never widens what the owner approved. `x-decision` is the table a pass decides a call with, `x-log` what a covered run writes.

schemaVersion.description: 1 = a record written before `covers` (read through the migration); 2 = written with `covers`.

id.description: A UUID for a stored pass, `feed:<service>:<id>` for a feed pass.

includeIrreversible.description: Only with covers `all`: irreversible calls run under the pass too.

quietNotice.description: true = one quiet `ran under pass` line per covered run; false (default) = a covered run sends no notice at all.

all.description: pass@1 mirror, still written: true exactly when covers is `all`.

service.description: pass@1 mirror, still written: `*` for covers `all`, else the one service every entry names, else `*`.

tools.description: pass@1 mirror, still written: `["*"]` for covers `all`, else the entries' tool patterns.

scopes.description: pass@1 mirror, still written: the entries' scope patterns; absent for covers `all`.

expiresAt.description: Any length the hub's longest-pass limit allows (24 hours must be allowed). Coverage does not depend on length.

uses.description: Calls that ran under this pass (the `runs` count pass_status shows).

pattern.description: `*` stands for any run of characters (none included); everything else is literal and case-sensitive; the whole name must match.

entry.description: One thing a pass covers. A call matches when the service matches, the tool matches, and (when `scope` is set) the call's control@1 `target` argument matches.

service.description: A service namespace, or `*` for any service (then `scope` is required).

tool.description: A tool name or pattern; left out = every tool of the service.

scope.description: A control@1 target (`tokens.theme`, `planner.builds`); a scoped entry never covers a call without a `target`.

covers.description: What the pass covers. `all` (the default for every new pass): every tool on every service, whatever its policy. A list: exactly the entries named.

coversRequest.description: `covers` as a grant or update may send it (pass_grant, pass_update, POST /auth/api/passes, the CLI, voice). Left out = `all`. A list item is an entry or its short form: `<service>` (every tool), `<service>.<tool>` (split at the first dot), `scope:<target>` (any service).

logEntry.description: What a call that ran under a pass adds to its job and its approvals-log entry.

ranUnder.description: The pass id. Present exactly when a pass let the call run.

passScope.description: The coverage label: `everything`, `everything, including irreversible calls`, or the entries.

x-decision.note: What an active pass that covers the call does with each policy. `always-approve` = a tool whose approval is always the owner's straight approval and never a countdown (annotation explicitApproval, or a destructive / guarded tool held at confirm), e.g. console_terminal_sessions_stop.

allow.why: runs anyway; no pass is used or named

deny.why: no pass ever lifts a deny

neverCovered.what: tools annotated ownerGrant (axhub.pass_grant, axhub.pass_update): a pass can't grant, widen or stretch a pass
a call the connector marks irreversible, unless covers is `all` and includeIrreversible is true
a call that carries a confirmation_id: it is the answer to an approval already asked
a pass past expiresAt by the hub's clock, or revoked

x-decision.pick: When several active passes cover a call, the one ending last is named in ranUnder.

x-log.audit: one audit entry per covered run: pass id, qualified tool, policy skipped, time
x-log.counter: the pass's `uses` goes up by one and `lastUsedAt` is set

x-migration.note: Read-time, on every reader (hub, web app, console). A record with a valid `covers` is read as is. A record with no `covers` reads as `all`, except a pass@1 record whose own fields name something narrower: that one keeps exactly what it named, as a list. A `covers` that is present but not valid covers nothing.
x-migration.storage: axHub SQLite migration 7: `ALTER TABLE passes ADD COLUMN covers TEXT` (NULL = not written yet; no backfill is needed, a backfill writes what the read rule answers).
rules: covers is `all` or a valid list → covers
covers present, anything else → none (the pass covers nothing; fail closed)
no covers, no narrow term (service absent or `*`, tools absent or only `*`, no scopes) → all
no covers, a narrow term → one entry per tool × scope: { service, tool (left out when `*`), scope? }

cases.name: pass@1 narrow: tools and a scope
pass@1 narrow: a scope on any service
pass@2 list wins over the mirrors
an entry for any service without a scope
